The [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] '''Ore Hauler''' was a heavy duty barge designed to transport large amounts of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]] or waiting [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. The craft was essentially an enclosed crew cabin coupled with an open cargo bed.
